newsitem.title: JAPAN: Eisai shares down on Nomura downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Eisai shares down on Nomura downgrade.

text.p: Shares of pharmaceuticals company Eisai Co Ltd fell sharply on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on early Tuesday morning after Nomura Research Institute Ltd downgraded the company, brokers said.
Nomura Research Institute downgraded Eisai to a "2" rating from its previous "1", market sources said earlier on Tuesday.
Eisai shares were down 70 yen at 2,210 at 0059 GMT.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "2" rating to issues whose values it sees moving within 10 percentage points in either direction of the key 225-share Nikkei average over the next six months.
